description.narrative: *Detta bidrag klassificeras som ett typ A projekt enligt policymarkören för insatser som syftar till att stödja Team Sweden och den privata sektorn inom konfektions- och textilindustrin i Bangladesh.* Projektet syftar till att utveckla en kommersiellt gångbar digital ESG-plattform för att effektivisera datahantering och stärka rapporteringen för Bangladeshs RMG- och exportinriktade sektorer. Det kommer också att integrera efterlevnad inom miljö-, sociala och styrningsområden, vilket stärker deras motståndskraft, konkurrenskraft och avkarbonisering.

*This contribution is tagged as a type A project in terms of the policy marker for contributing to Team Sweden/Private Sector in the ready-made garment/textile sectors in Bangladesh.* The project aims to develop a commercially viable digital ESG platform to streamline data management and strengthen reporting for Bangladesh's RMG and export-oriented sectors. It will also mainstream compliance across environmental, social, and governance areas, enhancing their resilience, competitiveness, and decarbonisation.

The proposed project- "Technology for Responsible Accountability in Corporate ESG- TRACE" is intended to contribute towards the overall development goals of reduced greenhouse gas emissions, reduced pollution of air, soil and water, reduced water use, safeguarded productive employment opportunities for primarily women, improved labour conditions, as well as improved transparency and accountability in the private sector with an initial focus on Bangladeshs ready-made garment industry. An additional positive side-effect is improvements in the competitiveness of the Bangladeshi factories in several international markets.
By the end of the intervention, Bangladeshs Ready-Made Garment (RMG) sector is expected to have undergone a systemic transformation towards data-driven, transparent, and accountable sustainability governance. The project will, according to Swisscontact, develop a commercially viable digital platform for environmental, social and governance (ESG) improvements. It shall decarbonize production through improved data quality, automated reporting, and knowledge sharing, and enhance companies resilience and competitiveness.
Through this initiative, a scalable, and inclusive digital sustainability platform will be established to consolidate ESG data across the sector, provide e-learning opportunities, and enable matchmaking between factories, brands, technology experts, and service and technology providers. Although the initial focus is on the RMG sector, the Platform is expected to be useful to many other sectors as well, already from the outset. If successful, the aim is to complement the Platform with additional material to also serve other sectors.
The digital ESG Platform aims to empower the entire RMG sector to enhance its ESG compliance. However, the project has a particular focus on otherwise underserved tier 2 and 3 factories, through i.a. free access to e-learning, a knowledge hub, and a reporting tool. It will also help factories, sustainability professionals and technology providers find each other through matchmaking.
The project will have two phases. By year two it is expected to have contributed to the following: ESG reporting will be digitalized, efficient, and standardized, producing automated reports aligned with several international stadards such as GRI, ESRS, and IFRS. Information asymmetry between factories, buyers, and service providers will be significantly reduced. At least 50 factories, 10 brands, and 15 service providers will be onboarded and actively using the platform during beta testing (years 12). 300 management staff and sustainability officers will have completed e-learning modules and strengthened their ESG competence. 20 matchmaking services will have connected factories, brands, and experts for advisory and auditing support. Early revenue of at least BDT 700,000 (SEK 55,000) will be generated through brand contributions supporting platform adoption.
In the medium term (years 35) the platform is expected to have contributed to the following results: It will have at least 500 active users (400 factories, 50 brands, and 50 service providers). A sustainable business model and ownership structure will be in place, with a designated platform steward. Data-driven decision-making and improved ESG reporting practices will be integrated into business operations of the factories. The platform will generate approximately BDT 12 million (SEK 900,000) in annual revenue. The broader ESG ecosystem will use the platforms insights for policy development, innovation, and co-creation of sustainability solutions.
In the long term (beyond Year 5), the project is expected to contribute to the following results: Improved working conditions, health, safety and other labor rights for 23,000 workers (60% women). A reduction of 7.1 million tons of CO emissions through improved environmental management and resource efficiency. Enhanced governance, transparency, and accountability across the value chain, strengthening the global competitiveness of Bangladeshs broader manufacturing sector.

tag.narrative: 1.5 - By 2030, build the resilience of the poor and those in vulnerable situations and reduce their exposure and vulnerability to climate-related extreme events and other economic, social and environmental shocks and disasters.

1.5 - Till 2030 bygga upp motståndskraften hos de fattiga och människor i utsatta situationer och minska deras utsatthet och sårbarhet för extrema klimatrelaterade händelser och andra ekonomiska, sociala och miljömässiga chocker och katastrofer.
5.5 - Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life.
5.5 - Tillförsäkra kvinnor fullt och faktiskt deltagande och lika möjligheter till ledarskap på alla beslutsnivåer i det politiska, ekonomiska och offentliga livet.

6.3 - By 2030, improve water quality by reducing pollution, eliminating dumping and minimizing release of hazardous chemicals and materials, halving the proportion of untreated wastewater and substantially increasing recycling and safe reuse globally.

6.3 - Till 2030 förbättra vattenkvaliteten genom att minska föroreningar, stoppa dumpning och minimera utsläpp av farliga kemikalier och material, halvera andelen obehandlat avloppsvatten och väsentligt öka återvinningen och en säker återanvändning globalt.
6.5 - By 2030, implement integrated water resources management at all levels, including through transboundary cooperation as appropriate.
6.5 - Senast 2030 genomföra en integrerad förvaltning av vattenresurser på alla nivåer, när så är lämpligt genom gränsöverskridande samarbete.

7.a - By 2030, enhance international cooperation to facilitate access to clean energy research and technology, including renewable energy, energy efficiency and advanced and cleaner fossil-fuel technology, and promote investment in energy infrastructure and clean energy technology.

7.a - Till 2030 stärka det internationella samarbetet för att underlätta tillgång till forskning och teknik inom ren energi, inklusive förnybar energi, energieffektivitet samt avancerad och renare fossilbränslebaserad teknik, samt främja investeringar i energiinfrastruktur och ren energiteknik.

9.1 - Bygga ut tillförlitlig, hållbar och motståndskraftig infrastruktur av hög kvalitet, inklusive regional och gränsöverskridande infrastruktur, för att stödja ekonomisk utveckling och människors välbefinnande, med fokus på ekonomiskt överkomlig och rättvis tillgång för alla.

9.1 - Develop quality, reliable, sustainable and resilient infrastructure, including regional and transborder infrastructure, to support economic development and human well-being, with a focus on affordable and equitable access for all.
